use implementation::{LazyLock, Mutex, PoisonError, RwLock};
use std::sync::{Arc, Barrier};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
use std::panic::{catch_unwind, AssertUnwindSafe};

fn main() {
    let calls = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let counted = calls.clone();
    let lazy = Arc::new(LazyLock::new(move || {
        counted.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        Mutex::new(0usize)
    }));
    let rw = Arc::new(RwLock::new((0usize, 0usize)));
    let start = Arc::new(Barrier::new(9));
    let handles: Vec<_> = (0..8).map(|_| {
        let (lazy, rw, start) = (lazy.clone(), rw.clone(), start.clone());
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            start.wait();
            for _ in 0..1000 {
                *lazy.lock().unwrap() += 1;
                {
                    let mut pair = rw.write().unwrap();
                    pair.0 += 1;
                    pair.1 = pair.0 * 2;
                }
                let a = rw.read().unwrap();
                let b = rw.read().unwrap();
                assert_eq!(a.1, a.0 * 2);
                assert_eq!(*a, *b);
            }
        })
    }).collect();
    start.wait();
    for h in handles { h.join().unwrap(); }
    assert_eq!(calls.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    assert_eq!(*lazy.lock().unwrap(), 8000);
    assert_eq!(*rw.read().unwrap(), (8000, 16000));

    let lock = Mutex::new(1usize);
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
        let mut guard = lock.lock().unwrap();
        *guard = 7;
        panic!("poison mutex");
    })).is_err());
    assert!(lock.is_poisoned());
    assert_eq!(*lock.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner), 7);
    lock.clear_poison();
    assert_eq!(*lock.lock().unwrap(), 7);

    struct DebugPanic(bool);
    impl std::fmt::Debug for DebugPanic {
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
            assert!(!self.0, "debug payload panic");
            f.write_str("payload")
        }
    }
    let debug = Mutex::new(DebugPanic(true));
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| format!("{debug:?}"))).is_err());
    assert!(debug.is_poisoned());
    debug.lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner).0 = false;
    assert_eq!(format!("{debug:?}"), "Mutex { data: payload, poisoned: true, .. }");

    let lock = RwLock::new(3usize);
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
        let _guard = lock.read().unwrap();
        panic!("reader must not poison");
    })).is_err());
    assert!(!lock.is_poisoned());
    assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
        let mut guard = lock.write().unwrap();
        *guard = 11;
        panic!("poison writer");
    })).is_err());
    assert!(lock.is_poisoned());
    assert_eq!(*lock.read().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner), 11);
    assert_eq!(*lock.write().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner), 11);
    lock.clear_poison();
    assert_eq!(*lock.read().unwrap(), 11);

    let calls = AtomicUsize::new(0);
    let lazy = LazyLock::new(|| {
        calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        panic!("poison lazy")
    });
    for _ in 0..2 {
        assert!(catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| { LazyLock::force(&lazy); })).is_err());
    }
    assert_eq!(calls.load(Ordering::Relaxed), 1);
    println!("host sync contention/poison ok");
}
